children: GLG, a Hong Kong-based golf-lifestyle platform, filed for an initial public offering on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol "GLG." The company plans to offer 5,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares at an estimated price range of $5.00 to $7.00 per share, implying a gross offering size of about $30 million at the midpoint. Net proceeds are earmarked for marketing, events, talent, equipment, and working capital.

GLG is a holding company with operations in Hong Kong through its wholly owned subsidiary, Golf Lifestyle Group Company Limited. The company offers an integrated golf-lifestyle ecosystem spanning corporate Group Services (professional training, business networking, and team-building in a unified event), event management (including the Hong Kong Golf Show), and the Golf Cards membership and payment platform that provides golf, travel, and lifestyle privileges.

GLG operates an asset-light model that leverages extensive third-party partnerships with golf courses, retail pro shops, travel operators, financial institutions, and service providers. Revenue is derived from Group Services engagements, exhibitor and sponsorship fees from events, and transaction-based income from the Golf Cards platform. Competitive strengths include deep industry relationships, a scalable partnership network, and growing digital capabilities to support member engagement and cross-selling across golf, travel, and lifestyle categories.
: Asia-Pacific golf equipment market projected to grow through 2033, with a 6.2% CAGR (2026–2033).
: Asia region counts 26.2 million adult golf participants, supporting demand for services and equipment.
: GLG aims to be a leading integrated golf-centric lifestyle brand in Hong Kong with an asset-light, partnership-driven model.
: Traditional golf clubs and academies, indoor simulator venues, lifestyle membership programs, travel agencies, and event organizers.
: Digital transformation (apps, payments, VR training), experiential and wellness-focused consumption, and increased visibility from major golf events.
: Approximately 70 corporate and group engagements in 2025.
: Headquarters and operations in Hong Kong.
: Services primarily delivered in Hong Kong.
: Presence in ~30 golf pro shops; collaborations with 50+ golf courses; partnerships with financial institutions.
: 2,000+ Golf Membership Cardholders; 700+ Golf Payment Cardholders; the Hong Kong Golf Show generated HK$4,150,002 revenue in 2025.

, Chief Executive Officer, Director and Chairman - 35+ years in finance and payments; former roles at Morgan Stanley, AIG Asset Management (Asia), and Allianz Dresdner; founder of two HKEX GEM-listed companies; BBA from University of North Texas.

, Chief Financial Officer - 10+ years in accounting, audit, and corporate finance; prior roles at Mas & Partners CPA, Delia Group of Schools, Greendotdot Limited, Brilliant Circle Holdings; CPA Canada and HKICPA member.

, Independent Director Nominee - Experience in private banking and wellness ventures; former VP, Private Banking at Hang Seng Bank; Managing Director at Aloha Wellness/Alchemy & Co.; holds a Bachelor’s degree from Lancaster University.

, Independent Director Nominee - 12+ years in corporate finance and Hong Kong capital markets; Director and Responsible Officer at Minerva Advisory Global Capital Limited; Juris Doctor from CUHK; Bachelor of Commerce from University of Queensland.

, Independent Director Nominee - 13+ years in auditing, governance, and compliance; Company Secretary/Authorized Representative for multiple HKEX-listed firms; Fellow of HKICPA; BBA (Hons) in Accountancy from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.
: 5,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares (underwriters’ 45-day option for 750,000 additional shares)

: Approx. 20% each to brand promotion and digital marketing; event staging and upfront capital; talent acquisition and team development; training and simulation equipment; and working capital/general corporate purposes.
